segments.he:
תּוֹרָה רכד
אֲפִלּוּ הָרְחוֹקִים מִן הַצַּדִּיק מְקַבְּלִים חִיּוּת וְהֶאָרָה מִמֶּנּוּ:
segments.en: The primary fear comes and approaches a person at the time of eating. Therefore one must guard greatly to eat in holiness — and to draw upon oneself the fear that comes to one then. And through this one merits all the above in §1 and §2.
